text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: gpu-pool-2 - 3 nodes reporting repeated container restarts and CUDA OOMs. spike in 5xxs over 5m. creating thread for on-call handoff (INC-3901).

mike_oncall: seeing same in prod. tails show paged allocator failing with OOMs then container crashloop.
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when allocating tensor of size ...
  at paged_allocator.cpp:432
  stack: ...
```

carla_eng: recent rollout of paged-allocator v3.4.1 ~2h ago touched the eviction heuristics. suspect slow kv-cache fragmentation + paged attention resident pages leaking.

ashley_pm: are customers impacted? any high-level numbers?

mike_oncall: ~2% error rate on /v1/generate across a subset of heavy-context requests (mostly 16k tokens+). A few long-running customers saw degraded tail latency -> some automatic fallback triggered. No full outage but customer-visible errors.

ryan_infra: cordoning affected nodes now: `kubectl drain gpu-node-11 gpu-node-12 gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` . spinning up replacements from spare pool.

ben_sre: temporary mitigation checklist: 1) cordon + drain affected nodes 2) enable aggressive kv eviction (hotfix env) 3) route traffic away from canary pool 4) rollback paged-allocator if safe.

liz_dev: I can push a hotfix that clears kv cache on startup and disables warmup to prevent immediate rewarm of fragmented pages: patch below.
```
# hotfix env
KV_CACHE_CLEAR_ON_START=true
KV_CACHE_WARMUP=false
KV_EVICT_RATIO=0.6
PAGED_ATTENTION_MAX_RESIDENT=0.85
```

carla_eng: good. also add a slower max_seq_length cap for large requests at the edge (reduce default from 16384 to 8192) so fewer requests hit the worst path.

mike_oncall: doing a canary rollback of paged-allocator -> v3.3.7 to two nodes, will monitor.

incident-bot: INC-3901 created, priority P2. linked: dashboards (token-level latency, per-node mem usage), runbook: paged-allocator.

ashley_pm: drafting customer comms: mention transient GPU memory pressure due to allocator fragmentation. will note mitigations and ETA for follow-up postmortem.

ben_sre: quick K8s status: 3 restarts on affected pods, a few OOMKilled entries in the last 10m. Metrics show resident set growth before OOMs (consistent with leak).

mike_oncall: after rollback + kv clear, restarted 2 nodes. no new OOMs in last 6m on those. overall error rate down to baseline. still watching.

liz_dev: added a safeguard to the allocator: if resident page fragmentation exceeds threshold, trigger periodic compaction and emit warning metric `paged.kv.compaction_triggered`. pushing to prod config now.

carla_eng: action items: - finish canary rollback across pool - keep aggressive eviction env for 60m - schedule postmortem and include heap profiler capture for next reproducer - add regression test for long-tail context workloads.

ashley_pm: customer-facing note queued for 15m. will escalate to account teams for any customers with >0.5% error rate.

mike_oncall: final for now: nodes stabilized, replaced the 3 flapping hosts, rollback applied cluster-wide, kv-clear hotfix rolled. monitoring for 1h before closing INC-3901. thanks all. :thumbsup:

ben_sre: leaving a reminder: follow up to validate no slow creeping memory after 24h and check telemetry for compaction triggers.

incident-bot: INC-3901 status: mitigated -> monitoring. timeline and notes added to ticket.
